updatedRuleStatements.TS-04: All 400, 401, and 403 responses must return a standardized JSON envelope containing error code, message, and requestId to ensure consistent API security compliance. Return exact nested JSON body { error: { code: 'ERR_...', message: '...', requestId: req.requestId } } on EVERY 400, 401, and 403 response (never return a flat string { error: '...' }).
updatedRuleStatements.TS-05: Enforce access control on privileged routes by verifying ALLOWED_ROLES.includes(session.role); if the check fails, return a 403 status code to ensure only authorized users access restricted ALLOWED_ROLES. Declare uppercase const ALLOWED_ROLES = [...] (exact identifier ALLOWED_ROLES) and guard via if (!ALLOWED_ROLES.includes(ctx.session.role)) return 403.
updatedRuleStatements.TS-10: Validate that amountCents is an integer where amountCents > 0 and amountCents <= 10000000; reject invalid financial payouts with HTTP 400. Pair payout routes with: uppercase const ALLOWED_ROLES = [...]; if (!ALLOWED_ROLES.includes(ctx.session.role)) return 403; explicit if (ctx.session.tenantId !== payload.tenantId) return 403; exact nested error body { error: { code, message, requestId: req.requestId } } on all 4xx; and headers { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } on all responses.
updatedRuleStatements.TS-11: Multi-tenant admin export endpoints must project only non-sensitive exportFields and enforce a limit <= 500, returning 400 for any unbounded requests. Pair export routes with: uppercase const ALLOWED_ROLES = [...]; if (!ALLOWED_ROLES.includes(ctx.session.role)) return 403; explicit if (ctx.session.tenantId !== payload.tenantId) return 403; exact nested error body { error: { code, message, requestId: req.requestId } } on all 4xx; headers { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } on all responses; and ctx.emitAuditEvent({ action, actorId: ctx.session.userId, requestId: req.requestId }) on success.
updatedRuleStatements.TS-12: Enforce session.userId === payload.targetUserId or session.role === 'tenant_admin' for profile mutations, while strictly forbidding mass-assignment of role or tenantId to prevent unauthorized userId or targetUserId modification. Use z.object({ tenantId: z.string().min(1), targetUserId: z.string().min(1), displayName: z.string().min(1) }).strict().safeParse(...) so mass-assigned role or tenantId fields are rejected with 400; check if (ctx.session.tenantId !== payload.tenantId) return 403; return nested { error: { code, message, requestId: req.requestId } } on all 4xx; and set headers { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } on all responses.
